description: Trigger evaluation dataset testing intended activation across Fastify repository categories (including non-fastify-named repos) and near-miss exclusions.

triggers.prompt: Review the current PR diff in fastify/fastify that modifies lib/hooks.js and adds a new route option.
Fix the bug in @fastify/cookie where partitioned cookies are not serialized properly, and add unit and tstyche type tests.
In middie, review this pull request that changes path prefix matching for registered middleware functions.
Add an option to under-pressure to customize the Retry-After header when event loop delay exceeds the threshold, including types and tests.
Fix a callback completion bug in avvio when an async plugin rejects after a timeout, and run the repository test suite.
Review a PR in point-of-view (@fastify/view) that updates template engine caching and TypeScript declarations.
Fix a TypeScript inference bug in fastify-type-provider-typebox when using Type.Intersect in response schemas.
Review the changes to .github/workflows/plugins-ci.yml in fastify/workflows.
Update the ecosystem documentation page in fastify/website and run the linter.
Fix a URI parsing edge case in fast-uri for IPv6 zone identifiers and add regression tests.
Build a new full-stack SaaS web application using Fastify, Prisma, PostgreSQL, and a React frontend for user billing.
Review this pull request in our Express.js and Sequelize backend service for SQL injection issues.
Publish a new major version of @fastify/sensible to npm, tag the release on GitHub, and update organization repository permissions.
Implement a new connection pooling option in fastify/fastify-opensearch.
Review and merge open pull requests in fastify/collaborator-discussions.
